parameters.name: Report Ad Product
parameters.description: Type of advertising product being reported. Allowed values: SPONSORED_PRODUCTS, SPONSORED_BRANDS, SPONSORED_DISPLAY, SPONSORED_TELEVISION, DEMAND_SIDE_PLATFORM

parameters.name: Report Columns
parameters.description: List of columns fetched from Reporting API

parameters.name: Report Filters
parameters.description: Set of filters used to trim returned data

parameters.name: Report Group By
parameters.description: Level of granularity of the report

parameters.name: Report Ingestion Strategy
parameters.description: Configuration of the report ingestion. Allowed values: snapshot, incremental

parameters.name: Report Ingestion Window
parameters.description: How many days from the past should be downloaded during incremental ingestion

parameters.name: Report Profile ID
parameters.description: The profile ID associated with an advertising account in a specific marketplace

parameters.name: Report Schedule
parameters.description: Create Amazon Ads Report processor schedule

parameters.name: Report Start Date
parameters.description: Start date from which the ingestion should happen

parameters.name: Report Time Unit
parameters.description: Date aggregation. Allowed values: DAILY, SUMMARY

parameters.name: Report Type
parameters.description: Data type contained in the report
